witness.branch: Left turn made from another lane where a two-way left-turn lane is designated.
witness.quote: A left turn shall not be made from any other lane where a two-way left-turn lane has been designated.
witness.reason: Adjacent lanes and a designated center-turn lane support a left-turn alternative originating in another lane.
required_context: Designation evidence and geometry of the two-way left-turn lane.
Ego's actual turn origin in an adjacent lane where the designation applies.
Establish municipal jurisdiction and designation evidence for the two-way left-turn lane, including its extent and governed movements.
Keep the first clause's preparing-for-or-making-a-left-turn exception separate; it is not an exception to the second clause.
Preserve unresolved maneuver meanings, designation standards and municipal incorporation of NRS definitions.
Provide a supported left-turn connection and document approach-lane adjacency and the actual lane from which the turn begins.
Retain vehicle classification, trajectory, footprint and lane occupancy through the maneuver.
Supported left-turn connection and the designated lane's relationship to the approach or receiving roadway.
witness.subject_reason: The selected motor vehicle makes the observed left turn; the prohibition is vehicle-based.
